lead: Imran Khan is a Pakistani politician, born on 5 October 1952 in Lahore.
As of 2026, he is 73 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has represented Pakistan national cricket team and has held the office of Prime Minister of Pakistan and chancellor.
This profile collects the Imran facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Imran Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Imran Khan was born on 5 October 1952 in Lahore, and holds Pakistani nationality.
Public records name his father, Ikramullah Khan Niazi and his mother, Shaukat Khanum.
He received his education at Keble College, Aitchison College, Royal Grammar School Worcester and University of Oxford.
He is recorded as speaking Urdu and English.

sections.heading: Imran Khan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, cricketer, autobiographer, investor and head of government as his occupations.
On the team sheet, Imran has been associated with Pakistan national cricket team (from 1971 to 1992).

He has held the following offices: Prime Minister of Pakistan (2018–2022), chancellor (2005–2014), party leader (1996–2023), Member of the 14th National Assembly of Pakistan (2013–2018), Member of the 15th National Assembly of Pakistan (2018–2022) and Federal Minister for Interior (2018–2019). He is affiliated with Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2013 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2020.
